response.title: Zapier to n8n migration for 6 workflows
response.description: We're moving off Zapier to our self-hosted n8n. We have 6 Zaps to rebuild: a form to Google Sheets, Sheets to Slack alerts, a Stripe payment to an email receipt, and three small Gmail filters. Rebuild each one in n8n, test it with us and hand over a short doc.
